newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: BOLSWESSANEN TO BUY U.S. FOOD GROUP.
newsitem.headline: BOLSWESSANEN TO BUY U.S. FOOD GROUP.

text.p: Dutch food and drinks concern BolsWessanen NV said on Tuesday it would acquire the U.S. group Specialty Foods Distributors.
The cost of the transaction, to be completed by cash settlement within a month, was not disclosed.
"Agreement has been reached on the acquisition of Specialty Foods Distributors Inc by Tree of Life, (BolWessanen's U.S. distribution operation)," BolsWessanen said in a statement.

It said Specialty Foods, based in Plant City, Florida, was a leading distributor of delicatessen and regional spcialities in the south east of the United States with an annual turnover of some 190 million guilders.
